title: Dedicated weatherproof storage area per Table 2.1b
text: Storage. C2.1.2 Each dwelling has exclusive use of a dedicated, weatherproof storage area in accordance with Table 2.1b.

replaces.note: R25 and below: 4m2 store for every dwelling -> 3m2 for studio/1 bed; min dimension 1.5 m -> 1 m; 'accessible from outside the dwelling' and matching materials dropped
min dimension 1.5 m -> 1 m; height 2.1 m -> 2 m

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding all codes, not R50+ and R100-SL. The Chapter 3 storage heading on p15 carries no density qualifier (Chapter 2's limits it to R50-R80, R100-SL, LR, MR, HR), so storage applies to grouped dwellings at every code (register ch3-021). Storage may be co-located in a garage or carport if a dedicated area; dimensions exclude services, plant, bins, bicycle parking and fixtures.
